(async()=>{const s=await import('/src/studio/store.ts');const m=await import('/src/studio/architect/model.ts');const p=await import('/src/studio/architect/persistence.ts');const id=s.useStudio.getState().job.id;const model=m.emptyProject(id);const w1=m.newWall(model,model.levels[0].id,[-2000,0],[2000,0],[{id:'solid-1',name:'Existing Concrete',thickness:200,kind:'solid',hatch:'concrete',densityKgM3:null,rateM2:null,supplierReference:'',rateRevision:'',wastePercent:0}]);w1.id='w-existing';w1.height=2700;w1.lifecycle={status:'existing',reference:'Survey S01'};model.walls.push(w1);const w2=m.newWall(model,model.levels[0].id,[0,0],[0,3000],[{id:'solid-2',name:'New Timber',thickness:200,kind:'solid',hatch:'concrete',densityKgM3:null,rateM2:null,supplierReference:'',rateRevision:'',wastePercent:0}]);w2.id='w-new';w2.height=2700;w2.lifecycle={status:'new',reference:'Brief N01'};model.walls.push(w2);p.saveArchitect(p.loadArchitect(id,localStorage),model,localStorage);return true;})()
